explanation: Sparse feature that fires almost only in the original phase at steps 2-3 (95% of mass; a little at t=4; essentially never at t=0-1, t>=5, or in the delimiter or copy phases). It acts like a soft conjunction over the first few tokens. The previous token is usually z (75% of mass; e and b are weaker substitutes). The current input is one of w,x,q,t,e,d,u,r,3,n (w and x are strongest). The prefix tokens come from 2,h,q,e,b,v,z,y (first_tok 2 and h are strongest). The strongest activations are on prefixes like 2 z z [w], q z z [x] and q e z [w]. Magnitude rises with how many of these favoured tokens line up; having only one or two of them gives weak or no activation, and the boolean conjunction cannot capture that additive behaviour (dev F1 0.48). It does not fire on 1, m or 0 as the current input, or when the previous token is c, j or a digit.
